story.lead: Nature has always been a part of how we care for ourselves.

chapters.label: Heritage
paragraphs: Across India, generations have used natural ingredients and traditional knowledge in everyday beauty and personal care.

chapters.label: Change
paragraphs: Modern lifestyles brought convenience, but moved us away from many of these practices.
chapters.quote: Much of that knowledge still lives in homes, gardens and local communities.

chapters.label: Reconnection
paragraphs: Vinaya is about finding that connection again.
Bringing together natural ingredients, traditional knowledge and time-tested practices, in a way that feels relevant to life today.

story.value: The value lies not only in the ingredients, but in understanding where they come from and respecting the knowledge behind them.
